answer_relevance.rationale: Directly and appropriately describes SRD5A2, androgen metabolism, DHT, and AR signaling.

biomedical_factual_correctness.rationale: Mostly accurate against the evidence, including SRD5A2-mediated DHT production and SRD5A2/AR involvement in 46,XY DSD. Some therapeutic claims about AR and MK-0773 as treatment-oriented are not clearly supported by the supplied evidence.

completeness.rationale: Covers the main supported components: androgen metabolism, DHT-mediated AR activity, clinical DSD/AIS context, BPH, prostate cancer/alopecia relevance, and inhibitor evidence.
